📁 00Admin — DSA WORKSPACE: CET LECTURERS TRAINING (SAQA ID 78965)
PURPOSE:
This folder contains DSA's contextualised delivery materials for the
15-day Systems Development training for CET lecturers (Venda, Mar-Apr 2026).
All materials align to SAQA ID 78965 via LCX-provided reference documents.
STRUCTURE:
• 01SAQAQualificationPack78965/ ← Reference docs (read-only)
• ModerationReadinessChecklistDSA.pdf ← QA checklist for assessments
• POEStructureTemplateDSA.pdf ← Standardised PoE index + VACS tracker
• FacilitatorCredentialTemplateDSA.docx ← CV/ID/registration checklist
• ModerationWorkflowNotesDSA.pdf ← Questions for LCX alignment
• SLADSAMuthwaksCET.pdf ← Scope summary (not legal contract)
• TrainingSchedule3BlocksMarApr2026.pdf ← 15-day session plan
• ContactListGTMikeThomas.xlsx ← Key stakeholders + roles
USAGE:
• • Reference docs (01a–01d) are READ-ONLY — do not edit.
• • DSA adaptations (this folder) are ACTIVE — update as needed.
• • All learner-facing materials live in /01Core/, /02Elective/, etc.
ATTRIBUTION:
Source qualification: SAQA ID 78965 (MICT SETA)
Contextualised by: LimpopoConnexion (LCX) + Data Science Academy (DSA)
Delivery partner: DSA under LCX accredited provider status
